rows.title: CT Capitol is overflowing with ideas for how to cut the sales tax
rows.standfirst: CT lawmakers have proposed reducing the 6.35% sales tax rate while also seeking to create new exemptions or restore old ones.

rows.title: Income tax cut in CT? Lamont plan could save middle class $440M
rows.standfirst: CT officials estimate the tax cuts would save most middle-class joint filers about $600 per year and single filers would save about $300.

rows.title: Many eyes on CT budget, which must address inequalities
rows.standfirst: CT legislators ordered the governor to show how the budget will address inequalities in education, housing and more, and many are watching.

rows.title: Lamont, lawmakers strike deal to renew CT budget controls
rows.standfirst: CT Gov. Ned Lamont and lawmakers agreed to renew CT budget controls for another decade, but plans for school funding grants are on hold.

rows.title: Lamont to propose $50.5B budget, more than $500M in tax relief
rows.standfirst: The 2-year budget would deliver the largest income tax cut in history and expand relief for working poor families and small businesses.

rows.title: Connecticut’s budget process, explained
rows.standfirst: The CT General Assembly approves a two-year state budget and bond package in odd-numbered years. Here’s a closer look at the process.

rows.title: Lamont to colleges: Adjust to life without federal pandemic aid
rows.standfirst: The administration says federal coronavirus aid to colleges was temporary, but many officials say it’s not that simple.

rows.title: Big new investments top Lamont’s human services budget
rows.standfirst: Child care rate hikes and erasure of medical debt are in Gov. Lamont’s budget proposal, but it does not increase key funding for nonprofits.

rows.title: CT budget: Lamont pitches big tax cuts in first budget of new term
rows.standfirst: Gov. Ned Lamont proposed a $50.5 billion budget with more than $500 million in tax relief, topped by Connecticut’s first major income tax cut.

rows.title: Lamont budget ignites debate on wealth inequality in CT
rows.standfirst: While Gov. Ned Lamont insists his budget proposal would reduce inequality in CT, legislators and interest groups asked if it will do enough.

rows.title: UConn threatens to pull sports from XL Center in response to cuts
rows.standfirst: UConn President Radenka Maric said covering a funding shortfall with tuition alone would mean hikes of $3,000 per student.

rows.title: After compromise, legislators extend CT’s ‘fiscal guardrails’
rows.standfirst: Compromises negotiated by Gov. Ned Lamont and legislative leaders produced the unanimous passage Thursday a bill extending reforms that have contributed to Connecticut’s fiscal turnaround.

rows.title: Lamont has proposed Connecticut’s next two-year budget. What’s in it?
rows.standfirst: Gov. Ned Lamont has presented lawmakers with a $50.5 billion two-year budget that would deliver an income tax cut. Here’s what he proposed.

rows.title: CT progressive coalition poll: Voters favor higher taxes on the rich
rows.standfirst: More than 70% of CT voters support higher state income taxes on households earning more than $1 million annually, according to a new poll.

rows.title: Lamont, legislators heading for a battle over CT spending cap
rows.standfirst: Legislators and others say CT has too many pressing education, health care and social service needs to focus solely on the spending cap.

rows.title: Gov. Ned Lamont pitched an income tax cut in CT. Here’s an overview of his proposal
rows.standfirst: Gov. Ned Lamont has offered the first major cut in CT income taxes since the tax was enacted in 1991. Here’s a breakdown of his proposal.
